pull.title: KAFKA-21193: Speed up SuppressionIntegrationTest and JoinStoreIntegrationTest
pull.body:
Six of the 14 cases in SuppressionIntegrationTest take 42 to 46 seconds
each. Each test method uses a fixed application id, so the
withHeaders=false and withHeaders=true runs share one consumer group,
and the second run waits until the previous member's session times out.
shouldUseDefaultSerdes also reused the "-shouldInheritSerdes" test id,
so it shared a group and topics with shouldInheritSerdes. The two
shouldShutdownWhen... tests were not affected, because their members
send a LeaveGroup when the stream thread fails.

This uses safeUniqueTestName(testInfo) for the test id, as #23594 did
for FineGrainedAutoResetIntegrationTest, so every run gets its own
application id and topics. The changelog topic names checked in
shouldAllowOverridingChangelogConfig and shouldCreateChangelogByDefault
were hard-coded with the old application id, so they are now built from
the application id.

JoinStoreIntegrationTest has the same issue: each of its two
parameterized tests reuses an application id across invocations, so the
withHeaders=true invocation waits about 45 seconds for the previous
member's session to time out. Both tests now use
safeUniqueTestName(testInfo) to give each invocation its own application
id. The changelog topic names checked in
streamJoinChangelogTopicShouldBeConfiguredWithDeleteOnlyCleanupPolicy
are now built from that id. Locally, the class went from 94.9s to 6.9s.

Local runs of SuppressionIntegrationTest on the same machine (1 run
before, 3 runs after):

- Test time: 289s before, 32.4 to 32.5s after
- Cases over 30s: 6 before, 0 after
- Result: 14 passed before and after

Reviewers: Ken Huang <s7133700@gmail.com>

issue.title: KAFKA-21148: Speed up JoinStoreIntegrationTest

repository.name: kafka
repository.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue.body:
Give each invocation of `JoinStoreIntegrationTest` a unique application
ID to avoid waiting for consumer group members left by the previous
invocation to expire.

Create a fresh Streams configuration for each invocation to prevent the
headers store format setting from leaking between parameterized cases.
Derive the expected changelog topic names from the generated application
ID.

### Testing

All four parameterized cases passed.

```bash
./gradlew :streams:integration-tests:test \
  --tests org.apache.kafka.streams.integration.JoinStoreIntegrationTest
```

### Performance
Compared both versions with two alternating runs each on the same local
machine.
JUnit suite durations exclude Gradle compilation time.
Version | Run 1 | Run 2 | Average
-- | -- | -- | --
Before | 95.199 s | 95.388 s | 95.294 s
After | 7.403 s | 7.540 s | 7.472 s

Average test duration decreased by approximately 92.2%. The second
parameterized invocation of each test decreased from approximately 45
seconds to 1.2 seconds.

Reviewers: Andy Huang (github:andyhuangdev), SunMin Lee <sunmin4142@gmail.com>
